C0445.title: Credit Card Brute-Force Attacks: An Overlooked Attack Vector
C0445.summary: A 2026 report identifies credit card brute-forcing, also known as BIN enumeration or card cracking, as a systemic vulnerability. Attackers exploit publicly available Bank Identification Numbers combined with the Luhn algorithm to perform distributed enumeration of Primary Account Numbers, expiration dates, and CVVs.
